[s01_e01_c01_u001] Monica Geller: There's nothing to tell! He's just some guy I work with!
[s01_e01_c01_u002] Joey Tribbiani: C'mon, you're going out with the guy! There's gotta be something wrong with him!
[s01_e01_c01_u003] Chandler Bing: All right Joey, be nice. So does he have a hump? A hump and a hairpiece?
[s01_e01_c01_u004] Phoebe Buffay: Wait, does he eat chalk?
[s01_e01_c01_u005] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u006] Phoebe Buffay: Just, 'cause, I don't want her to go through what I went through with Carl- oh!
[s01_e01_c01_u007] Monica Geller: Okay, everybody relax. This is not even a date. It's just two people going out to dinner and- not having sex.
[s01_e01_c01_u008] Chandler Bing: Sounds like a date to me.
[s01_e01_c01_u009] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u010] Chandler Bing: Alright, so I'm back in high school, I'm standing in the middle of the cafeteria, and I realize I am totally naked.
[s01_e01_c01_u011] #ALL#: Oh, yeah. Had that dream.
[s01_e01_c01_u012] Chandler Bing: Then I look down, and I realize there's a phone... there.
[s01_e01_c01_u013] Joey Tribbiani: Instead of...?
[s01_e01_c01_u014] Chandler Bing: That's right.
[s01_e01_c01_u015] Joey Tribbiani: Never had that dream.
[s01_e01_c01_u016] Phoebe Buffay: No.
[s01_e01_c01_u017] Chandler Bing: All of a sudden, the phone starts to ring. Now I don't know what to do, everybody starts looking at me.
[s01_e01_c01_u018] Monica Geller: And they weren't looking at you before?!
[s01_e01_c01_u019] Chandler Bing: Finally, I figure I'd better answer it, and it turns out it's my mother, which is very-very weird, because- she never calls me!
[s01_e01_c01_u020] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u021] Ross Geller: Hi.
[s01_e01_c01_u022] Joey Tribbiani: This guy says hello, I wanna kill myself.
[s01_e01_c01_u023] Monica Geller: Are you okay, sweetie?
[s01_e01_c01_u024] Ross Geller: I just feel like someone reached down my throat, grabbed my small intestine, pulled it out of my mouth and tied it around my neck...
[s01_e01_c01_u025] Chandler Bing: Cookie?
[s01_e01_c01_u026] Monica Geller: Carol moved her stuff out today.
[s01_e01_c01_u027] Joey Tribbiani: Ohh.
[s01_e01_c01_u028] Monica Geller: Let me get you some coffee.
[s01_e01_c01_u029] Ross Geller: Thanks.
[s01_e01_c01_u030] Phoebe Buffay: Ooh! Oh!
[s01_e01_c01_u031] Ross Geller: No, no don't! Stop cleansing my aura! No, just leave my aura alone, okay?
[s01_e01_c01_u032] Phoebe Buffay: Fine! Be murky!
[s01_e01_c01_u033] Ross Geller: I'll be fine, alright? Really, everyone. I hope she'll be very happy.
[s01_e01_c01_u034] Monica Geller: No you don't.
[s01_e01_c01_u035] Ross Geller: No I don't, to hell with her, she left me!
[s01_e01_c01_u036] Joey Tribbiani: And you never knew she was a lesbian...
[s01_e01_c01_u037] Ross Geller: No!! Okay?! Why does everyone keep fixating on that? She didn't know, how should I know?
[s01_e01_c01_u038] Chandler Bing: Sometimes I wish I was a lesbian... Did I say that out loud?
[s01_e01_c01_u039] Ross Geller: I told mom and dad last night, they seemed to take it pretty well.
[s01_e01_c01_u040] Monica Geller: Oh really, so that hysterical phone call I got from a woman at sobbing 3:00 A.M., "I'll never have grandchildren, I'll never have grandchildren." was what? A wrong number?
[s01_e01_c01_u041] Ross Geller: Sorry.
[s01_e01_c01_u042] Joey Tribbiani: Alright Ross, look. You're feeling a lot of pain right now. You're angry. You're hurting. Can I tell you what the answer is?
[s01_e01_c01_u043] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u044] Joey Tribbiani: Strip joint! C'mon, you're single! Have some hormones!
[s01_e01_c01_u045] Ross Geller: I don't want to be single, okay? I just... I just- I just wanna be married again!
[s01_e01_c01_u046] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u047] Chandler Bing: And I just want a million dollars!
[s01_e01_c01_u048] Monica Geller: Rachel?!
[s01_e01_c01_u049] Rachel Green: Oh God Monica hi! Thank God! I just went to your building and you weren't there and then this guy with a big hammer said you might be here and you are, you are!
[s01_e01_c01_u050] Waitress: Can I get you some coffee?
[s01_e01_c01_u051] Monica Geller: De-caff. Okay, everybody, this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor. This is everybody, this is Chandler, and Phoebe, and Joey, and- you remember my brother Ross?
[s01_e01_c01_u052] Rachel Green: Hi, sure!
[s01_e01_c01_u053] Ross Geller: Hi.
[s01_e01_c01_u054] Unknown Speaker: 
[s01_e01_c01_u055] Monica Geller: So you wanna tell us now, or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?
[s01_e01_c01_u056] Rachel Green: Oh God... well, it started about a half hour before the wedding. I was in the room where we were keeping all the presents, and I was looking at this gravy boat. This really gorgeous Lamauge gravy boat. When all of a sudden- Sweet 'n' Lo?- I realized that I was more turned on by this gravy boat than by Barry! And then I got really freaked out, and that's when it hit me: how much Barry looks like Mr. Potato Head. Y'know, I mean, I always knew looked familiar, but... Anyway, I just had to get out of there, and I started wondering 'Why am I doing this, and who am I doing this for?'. So anyway I just didn't know where to go, and I know that you and I have kinda drifted apart, but you're the only person I knew who lived here in the city.
[s01_e01_c01_u057] Monica Geller: Who wasn't invited to the wedding.
[s01_e01_c01_u058] Rachel Green: Ooh, I was kinda hoping that wouldn't be an issue...
